events.title: Playtest is NOW LIVE!
events.summary: We are excited to share, that we just launched our very first playtest! Make sure to sign up on our Store page, to grant access as early as possible. Over the next few weeks we will grant access to more and more playtesters. The best way to provide feedback is to join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/cy25R6CyCG Please note: Bugs and localisation issues are to be expected! For this very first playtest we only support English and German localisation in the Game. More locales will follow! Fo

events.title: Discord Launch & Closed Beta
events.summary: Hey everyone! We just launched our Discord Server and would like to invite you, if you want to keep up to date about development. Additionally, we will do a Closed Beta Playtest early/mid March. We will send out Steam Beta Keys to interested players, so make sure to join the Discord if you'd like to be part of the Playtest :) Discord: https://discord.com/invite/cy25R6CyCG

events.title: Visual Overhaul and Design Adjustments
events.summary: We have been working a lot on the game recently and one of the big topics was the visual overhaul. So far we only had placeholder assets, to make a playable prototype. This has changed now, and we are proud to present our new visual style for the game! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186417/57235f63104558f22babea6f48cdb77ca61ab4bb.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186417/846dbd5f2dcfa85a1b9ce3ec9f393c1385b87d13.png Let us know what you think of the new Style!
